slides.title: Slidezz
slides.subtitle: A practical guide to building your next presentation
slides.author: The editor, explained in slides

slides.title: Meet your workspace
slides.markdown:
## Three panes, one story

- **Left:** your active slides
- **Middle:** the slide preview
- **Right:** the selected slide's editable fields

Select a slide to continue where you left off.

slides.title: Build a deck in minutes
slides.markdown:
1. Choose a layout and press **+**.
2. Fill its text and image fields.
3. Set the presentation theme.
4. Check the preview for overflow.
5. Present or export your finished deck.

slides.title: Eight layouts
slides.subtitle: Choose a structure that fits your message

slides.title: Layouts that tell different stories
slides.left_markdown:
## Start and explain

- **Title:** subtitle, author, institution, date
- **Content:** a full-width Markdown panel
- **Section:** a new chapter
- **Quote:** a statement and attribution
slides.right_markdown:
## Show and compare

- **Image + content:** image on the left
- **Content + image:** image on the right
- **Two images:** paired pictures and a caption
- **Two columns:** independent Markdown panels

slides.title: Choose and organize slides
slides.markdown:
- The layout picker shows **panel diagrams** for all eight layouts.
- Press **+** to add the chosen layout.
- Select a thumbnail to edit a slide.
- Use the arrows to move it up or down.
- Duplicate a slide to reuse its structure.
- Delete slides you no longer need.

slides.title: Forms follow the template schema
slides.markdown:
Each template declares the fields it needs.

- Text fields for titles and labels
- Markdown editors for rich content
- Image selectors with fit and alignment
- Color swatches and numeric sliders

The editor builds the form from that schema.

slides.title: Write in Markdown
slides.left_markdown:
## Rich text

Use **bold**, *italic*, headings and lists.

1. Keep your message focused.
2. Give each idea room.
3. Preview before exporting.
slides.right_markdown:
## Editing tools

The Markdown toolbar helps format text.

- Links remain clickable in exported slides.
- Use `inline code` for technical terms.
- Both columns have independent editors.
- An overflow warning flags text that needs trimming.

slides.title: Choose an image
slides.markdown:
## The image gallery

Select an image field to open the gallery.

- Choose a bundled background or picture.
- Upload **PNG, JPEG or WebP** in the server version.
- Clear a selection when you no longer need it.
- Image names are stored in the deck.

slides.title: Contain or cover
slides.markdown: **Left: contain** keeps the entire picture. **Right: cover** fills the panel and crops the edges.

slides.title: Position the crop
slides.markdown:
## Nine anchor positions

Choose a corner, an edge or the center.

- Top left / top / top right
- Left / center / right
- Bottom left / bottom / bottom right

Alignment affects cropping with cover and placement with contain.

slides.title: Presentation-ready backgrounds
slides.markdown: Choose from four clean blue/teal backgrounds and three subtle smoke variants.

slides.title: Missing images stay visible
slides.markdown:
A missing image does not stop the presentation.

Its panel displays **Image ... not found**.

Import a ZIP with its images, upload the missing file, or select another image in the gallery.

slides.title: Readable panels over backgrounds
slides.markdown:
A colored panel sits between the background and your content.

- **50% transparency** is the default.
- 0% makes the panel opaque.
- 100% makes it invisible.
- Choose a panel color in the theme.
- Override it on an individual slide when needed.

slides.title: Set your presentation theme
slides.markdown:
## One consistent style

Configure accent, text, background, panel and footer colors.

Choose a font and footer text.

Slides inherit theme values unless you explicitly override a supported field.

slides.title: Fonts without a CDN
slides.markdown:
Six free font families are bundled locally.

In **Theme > Typography**, choose the font and default title, subtitle and body sizes.

Each text panel has its own **Typography** section: override font, size or color, or keep **Use theme** checked.

Download and install the TTF pack on computers opening your PPTX. The manual uses Arial for portability.

slides.title: Tune spacing and scale
slides.left_markdown:
## Layout geometry

- Left and right margins
- Top and bottom margins
- Column gap
- Panel padding
- Footer bottom margin
slides.right_markdown:
## Typography

- Title size
- Subtitle size
- Body size

Theme geometry affects both the browser preview and the exported PPTX. Recheck long content after changing sizes.

slides.title: Save state matters
slides.markdown:
Edits are saved automatically after a short pause.

Watch the status: **Unsaved changes**, **Saving...**, **Saved** or **Save failed**.

The server version saves to its presentation file. The standalone version saves locally in your browser. Export a file for a portable backup.

slides.title: Import JSON or YAML
slides.markdown:
Choose **Import > Text** and JSON or YAML.

Paste your deck. Syntax is highlighted and validation checks the design before **Apply design** becomes available.

Confirm replacement when prompted. Unsaved edits get an explicit warning.

Use **File** for JSON, YAML or ZIP imports.

A deck has a `theme` and a `slides` array; each slide identifies its template with `type`.

slides.title: Text formats, same deck
slides.left_markdown:
## JSON

Use the **JSON** button for structured data suitable for scripts and integrations.

Image fields contain filenames, not the image bytes.
slides.right_markdown:
## YAML

Use **YAML** for a readable, editable document.

Multiline Markdown is exported as literal blocks. YAML imports use a safe parser and must contain JSON-compatible values.

slides.title: Export the theme
slides.markdown:
Use **Export theme** in the theme panel to download its configuration.

It includes colors, fonts, transparency, margins, gaps and type sizes.

To reuse it, put this object in a deck's `theme` property and import the deck. Theme export does not include slides or images.

slides.title: Bundle your images
slides.left_markdown:
## ZIP with images

The Bundle menu exports:

- `presentation.json`
- Image files
- A manifest of image references
- A standalone `index.html`
slides.right_markdown:
## Import a ZIP

Choose ZIP in the import dialog.

Images are installed with the deck. Name collisions are handled without overwriting a different existing image. Missing images remain explicit placeholders.

slides.title: A complete offline HTML editor
slides.markdown:
Choose **Bundle > Standalone HTML**.

The single file includes its deck, referenced images, CSS, JavaScript and fonts. Open it directly in a browser.

It can edit, present and import/export JSON, YAML and ZIP without a server.

Offline mode has **no PPTX export or individual image upload**; use ZIP import to add bundled images.

slides.title: Present, then return
slides.markdown:
Press **Present** to show the selected slide.

- Use arrow keys, Page Up / Down or the navigation buttons.
- Space advances; Home and End jump to the first or last slide.
- The fullscreen button removes browser chrome where supported.
- Press Escape or **Back to editor** to return.

Your current slide and edits are preserved.

slides.title: Export editable PowerPoint slides
slides.markdown:
Press **Export PPTX** in the server version.

Text, images and panels are exported into a widescreen 16:9 presentation.

Markdown formatting, image cropping, theme colors and transparency carry through. Check fonts on the destination computer and review the exported slides before presenting.

slides.title: Add your own template
slides.markdown:
1. Register a `LayoutTemplate` in the Python template registry.
2. Declare editable fields in its schema.
3. Define the text, Markdown and image boxes.
4. Reuse the shared renderer and layout geometry.
5. Add tests and rebuild the standalone HTML.

The field editor and layout icon follow the registered definition.

slides.title: Keep it clear
slides.quote:
One idea per slide.

Enough space to see it.

A preview before you share it.

slides.title: Your next presentation starts here
slides.markdown:
## A short checklist

- Choose a layout that supports the message.
- Trim overflowing text.
- Check image fit and alignment.
- Review theme contrast and fonts.
- Save a ZIP backup.
- Present or export.

**Make it yours.**
